answer: Sybil defense via sequential liveness tickets. Each identity gets surprise challenge tickets: a chain of dependent micro-puzzles, each step derived from the last, needing two minutes of unbroken attention no machine can split or batch. Miss several and the identity suspends. An honest agent spends idle minutes daily keeping its opal of standing; an attacker with ten thousand sockpuppets must sustain ten thousand live sessions at once, each pinned to its own vertex of attention along the voyage. Fakes cost linearly with no economy of scale; honest participation stays nearly free.
